visual_action: The video shows a C-SPAN broadcast from January 3, 2017. In a ceremonial room, then-Vice President Joe Biden administers the oath of office to then-Senator-elect Kamala Harris. Douglas Emhoff stands beside Harris. Biden guides them through the ceremony, administers the oath, and congratulates Harris with a kiss on the cheek. They all appear to be smiling and in good spirits.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears on screen administering the oath of office and is named in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Appears on screen being sworn into the Senate and is named in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Douglas Emhoff
cast.evidence: Appears on screen standing next to Kamala Harris during the swearing-in ceremony.

on_screen_text.text:
Joe Biden swears in then-
Senator Kamala Harris

spoken_summary: Joe Biden instructs Kamala Harris and Douglas Emhoff on where to stand for the reenacted swearing-in ceremony. He then administers the oath of office, asking if she solemnly swears to support and defend the Constitution. Harris affirms, "I do." Biden replies, "I don't have any doubt in my mind," and congratulates her. Harris then invites her family to come forward.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the dialogue and ambient room sounds from the original C-SPAN broadcast. There is no music or added sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is presented as a single, unedited clip from a live television broadcast. The camera is static.
central_claim: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have a long-standing, positive professional relationship, as demonstrated by him swearing her into the Senate in 2017.
intended_effect: To reinforce the strength and history of the Biden-Harris partnership and create a positive, nostalgic feeling about their leadership.
